32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol palette and clean card grid show design intent, but 5 of 9 cells render empty in the screenshot due to staggered animation timing, leaving the demo's core content invisible at capture time.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: Bar/area morphs maintain zero baselines correctly and stacked-bar height math is sound for linear scales, but all domains are hardcoded to synthetic values rather than data-driven, and the treemap↔circles morph approximates circles with rounded rects introducing a minor area mismatch.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: No user interactions eliminate Update Storm, Infinite Loop, Stale Scale, and Touch Fight risks entirely, but cells 5–9 use `.end().then(cb)` with no `.catch()`, so any interrupted transition silently breaks the animation loop permanently; no `.interrupt()` guards are present anywhere in the morph chain.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9-cell gallery with independent looping morphs is a manageable small-multiples format — each cell is self-contained, colors are restrained per cell (1–3 hues except Scatter↔Bar's 8-color palette), and staggered init avoids a simultaneous animation burst, though 9 concurrent animations in a static viewport do compete for peripheral attention.
